title: President Trump signs an executive order requiring federal government agencies to refer to AI as "Super Intelligence" or "SI" in all official communications (Michael Shepard/Bloomberg)
summary: Michael Shepard / Bloomberg: President Trump signs an executive order requiring federal government agencies to refer to AI as “Super Intelligence” or “SI” in all official communications — President Donald Trump sees artificial intelligence as suffering from a branding problem …
